# The Kit Ledger — AI agent prompt kits

> Free sample AI agent prompt templates for inbox triage, content repurposing and pre-deploy code review. Complete paid kits are sold on Payhip by The Kit Ledger.

This repository is a public, copy-paste-ready set of lite samples. Each sample is useful on its own: a core system prompt plus one workflow, for ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar agents. The samples are intentionally incomplete. They are not the paid kits.

Audience: vibe coders, people building AI agents, and anyone who ships small tools or posts about tech and games.

The free samples are MIT-licensed. The paid kits are not included in this repository and are not licensed under MIT.

Shop: https://payhip.com/TheKitLedger

Weekly digest (free): https://fitzs-newsletter.beehiiv.com

## Free samples

- [Inbox Triage Agent (lite)](samples/inbox-triage-agent/): Sort new email into Action, Later or Needs you, draft short replies, and never send mail. Includes safety rules, a system prompt, and a first-run prompt.
- [Content Repurposing Desk (lite)](samples/content-repurposing-desk/): Turn one transcript, blog post or set of notes into a short set of X posts, in the owner's voice, with no invented facts.
- [Ship-Ready Review Agent (lite)](samples/ship-ready-review-agent/): A secrets-and-config first pass before a vibe-coded app gets a public URL. Returns evidence and paste-ready fix prompts. Does not push, deploy, or rotate credentials.

## Full paid kits

- [Inbox Triage Agent, £19](https://payhip.com/b/XA6ah): A complete daily inbox setup. Adds an eight-label scheme, classification rubric, draft-reply patterns, daily digest template, extra prompts, a seven-day review checklist, and a setup guide.
- [Content Repurposing Desk, £29](https://payhip.com/b/Z9IQt): A desk-in-a-folder for a week of drafts. Adds a voice worksheet, weekly workflow, recipes for X, short video and email, a full output pack, second-cut prompts, and a human review checklist.
- [Ship-Ready Review Agent, £24](https://payhip.com/b/gl83D): A full pre-deploy review for agent-built apps. Adds a six-area checklist (secrets, auth, environment, errors, data, deploy and rollback), a GO / FIX FIRST / NO-GO report, fix prompts, and prompts for Cursor, Claude Code and chat agents.
